nodes.label: InputClean application and login-command entry
nodes.rationale: Handles optional login registration commands or starts the AppKit application. Diagnostics are opt-in.

nodes.label: Opt-in aggregate input diagnostics
nodes.rationale: INPUTCLEAN_DIAGNOSTICS records selected modes, device sender IDs and blocked/passed counts without keystrokes or coordinates.

nodes.label: Five distinct Escape presses
nodes.rationale: Consecutive presses must be within 1.5 seconds; holding Escape does not count and another key resets the sequence. A five-minute timeout also restores input.

nodes.label: Temporary cleaning event filter
nodes.rationale: Runs only during cleaning; confines trackpad movement to the last allowed cursor position and suppresses its events. Identified mouse events return unchanged. Temporary tap interruptions resume when macOS permits.

nodes.label: Native external mouse preservation
nodes.rationale: External mouse events pass through unchanged, preserving macOS sensitivity and acceleration. Trackpad input remains usable in keyboard-only mode.

nodes.label: Keyboard and media-key filtering limits
nodes.rationale: Ordinary keys, modifiers and media controls are blocked from all keyboards. Power, Touch ID and macOS-reserved controls remain outside app control.

nodes.label: Logic, menu regression and UI checks
nodes.norm_label: logic, menu regression and ui checks
nodes.rationale: Checks cover distinct Esc sequences, mode-specific filtering, unchanged native mouse events, mode reuse after recovery, deferred menu activation, card layout, accessibility and resource cleanup.

nodes.label: Optional native login startup
nodes.rationale: The executable supports enable-login, disable-login and login-status. Build does not enable startup; native registration requires macOS 13 or later.

nodes.label: Mac Mouse Fix device attribution reference
nodes.norm_label: mac mouse fix device attribution reference

nodes.norm_label: dark rounded card surface with fine light border

nodes.label: Divider above muted Click to pause and Ctrl-click for options instructions
nodes.norm_label: divider above muted click to pause and ctrl-click for options instructions

nodes.label: Teal dot beside Trackpad ready status
nodes.norm_label: teal dot beside trackpad ready status

nodes.label: Capture click type and Control modifier before UI dismissal
nodes.norm_label: capture click type and control modifier before ui dismissal
nodes.rationale: Click type and the Control modifier are captured before hiding the hover card so dismissal cannot change the chosen icon action. Control-click provides the mode menu when trackpad secondary click is unavailable.

nodes.label: CGEvent sender field 87 and IORegistry routing
nodes.norm_label: cgevent sender field 87 and ioregistry routing
nodes.rationale: Unknown pointing-device sources are suppressed, which may block drivers or generated pointer events that hide their hardware source. Escape remains available for recovery.

nodes.label: Glass card, IOSurface and deferred-window cleanup
nodes.norm_label: glass card, iosurface and deferred-window cleanup
nodes.rationale: Clear Liquid Glass on macOS 26+ has a translucent popover fallback. One IOSurface draws system typography. Temporary surfaces and window are released on dismissal, and a local event wakes AppKit to drain deferred resources. A space-efficient allocator reduces retained heap memory; no repeating cursor polling timer exists.

nodes.label: Logic check entry
nodes.rationale: Checks Escape sequences, mode-specific filters, event masks, right-click and Control-click menu classification, and byte-for-byte native mouse preservation.

nodes.label: Native keyboard, trackpad, cursor and sparkle PNG renderer
nodes.norm_label: native keyboard, trackpad, cursor and sparkle png renderer
nodes.rationale: Uses CoreGraphics and ImageIO to render a teal rounded tile, keyboard, recessed trackpad, overlapping cursor and cleaning sparkle to the supplied PNG path.

nodes.label: Build and run live-session sampler
nodes.rationale: Compiles tests/resource-sample.c and runs its binary against the supplied app PID, writing live-performance.json.

nodes.label: Live RAM and CPU session sampler
nodes.norm_label: live ram and cpu session sampler
nodes.rationale: Records every half-second; finishes after all three modes and ten idle seconds or after ten minutes. Cleaning values map idle=0, trackpad=1, keyboard=2, both=3.

nodes.label: Physical footprint, lifetime peak and one-core CPU samples
nodes.norm_label: physical footprint, lifetime peak and one-core cpu samples

nodes.label: Event-tap cleaning mode detection
nodes.rationale: Pointer and system-defined event-mask bits identify idle=0, trackpad=1, keyboard=2, both=3.

nodes.label: Menu mode regression, card layout and cleanup entry
nodes.norm_label: menu mode regression, card layout and cleanup entry
nodes.rationale: ModeProbe asserts no start during menuOpen; regression selects a mode, stops and toggles, then verifies reuse. It also drives menu tracking and checks card text, accessibility and cleanup. This is regression coverage, not physical menu validation.

nodes.label: Deferred activation after menu tracking
nodes.rationale: Menu selections start the filter after AppKit exits its tracking loop. The ModeProbe regression asserts that startCleaning never runs while menuOpen and verifies reuse after stop/toggle. README records physical keyboard blocking, five-Esc recovery, trackpad blocking and native mouse behavior as checked; the final Control-click menu and combined mode remain awaiting confirmation.

nodes.label: Session-selected cleaning mode retention
nodes.rationale: Trackpad-only is the initial default. A menu choice controls subsequent icon toggles for the current session, including after input is restored.
